findings.evidence: Lines 161–174 and 201–215 state equations whose outer operations are respectively `visit`, `over`, `sign`, and `partner`; Mathlib likewise names `(p.mirror).coeff` as `Polynomial.coeff_mirror`.
findings.fix: Rename them to `visit_mirror`, `over_mirror`, `sign_mirror`, `partner_mirror`, and the corresponding `*_relabel` names.
findings.issue: The projection lemmas put the transformation before the observed field: `mirror_visit`, `mirror_over`, `mirror_sign`, `mirror_partner`, `relabel_visit`, `relabel_over`, `relabel_sign`, and `relabel_partner`. This conflicts with the conclusion-outward rule and even with `writhe_mirror`/`writhe_relabel` in this file.

findings.evidence: Lines 252–253 call the object “The one-crossing positive kink,” and the roadmap’s Lickorish reference uses the term “kink”; no `oneCrossingPositive` precedent exists in TauCeti or Mathlib.
findings.fix: Rename the definition to `positiveKink` and rename lines 270–288 accordingly, preferably using conclusion-outward names such as `visit_positiveKink` and `writhe_positiveKink`.
findings.issue: `oneCrossingPositive` reverses the standard noun phrase and omits the actual object name: both its docstring and the cited source call this a “positive kink.” Its five associated theorem names inherit the misleading stem.

summary: Several introduced names do not read from their conclusions outward or use the source terminology consistently.
